title: Maki Fujita's Ka no Yo no Kemono ga Miru Yume wa Manga Ends
content: The manga's story centers on Sera, a high school girl who easily gets into trouble. She gets a detestable new bodyguard who crushes people without hesitation. Fujita launched the manga in Monthly Princess in May 2024.
author: ANN

title: Shonen Jump’s Biggest Sequel Ever Hits Its 10th Anniversary as the Series Gets More Intense Than Ever
content: Shonen Jump has consistently produced manga for decades, but only a few have stood out. One of the most outstanding manga of the 2000s is undeniably Naruto , a story fans often dub the perfect ninja series for how well it captures the genre’s nuances.
author: ComicBook

title: R-Type Dimensions III Game Launches Digitally on May 19
content: ININ Games announced on Thursday that the R-Type Dimensions III side-scrolling shooter game will launch digitally on May 19. title: Legendary Akira Creator Returns with New Anime After 12 Years
content: The creator of the Akira series, Katsuhiro Otomo, has left a legendary mark on the world of anime and manga, and his latest move may be his biggest contribution to the industry yet.

title: Piccoma to Launch Short-Form Anime Category in Late May
content: Piccoma , the subsidiary of Kakao, announced on April 27 it is set to introduce a new short-form animation category titled “ANIME” in late May, expanding its platform beyond comics and novels.
author: ANN

title: K Manga Adds LDK Pink Sequel Manga
content: Kodansha 's K MANGA platform announced on Thursday it has added Ayu Watanabe 's L♡DK Pink ( LDK Pink ) sequel series in English. Kodansha describes the series: Sequel to the beloved manga L♡DK!
author: ANN

title: 'Go for It, Nakamura!' Anime Reveals New Cast Member
content: The staff for the television anime of Syundei 's Go for It, Nakamura! ( Ganbare! Nakamura-kun!! ) boys-love manga revealed on Monday that Shōya Chiba will join the anime's cast as Arandō Tamura, a director and screenwriter of Hoshimi High School's drama and film club.
author: ANN

title: Let Me Fix You Short Anime Rescheduled to Mid-June Without Buta Productions, FAR
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for the short anime of Sakura Kurihara 's Let Me Fix You ( Kimi o Tsumugu ) yuri manga stated on Friday that the anime is now planned to be released in mid-June.
author: ANN
